card.name: Antidote, cyanide and poison control words
card.fires_on: The last piece of poisoning-related terms: the end of "antidote" (ote), the end of "cyanide" (ide), and "Poison" in "Regional Poison Control Center". It appears in overdose and poisoning treatment text.
